items: Transition metals sakht aur mazboot (rigid) solids hain.
Copper ke siwa, jo laal-bhoora (reddish brown) hai, baqi sab chandi jaisi ya grey chamakdar (lustrous) metals hain.
In ka atomic radius aam tor par baen se daen kam hota hai, lekin aakhir mein thora barh jata hai. Yeh increase (izafa) copper ke poore bhare d-subshell ki stability se juda hai.
In ke melting aur boiling points oonche hain; row mein baen se daen yeh upar neeche hote hain (variable trend), jaisa Figure 18.1 mein hai.
Yeh bijli aur heat ke achhe conductors hain.
In ki density zyada hai aur titanium se copper tak aam tor par barhti hai, kyun ke nuclear charge barhta aur atom ka size chhota hota jata hai.
In ki surface (satah) chamakdar hai; yeh malleable (hathode se patli chaadar ban sakti hain) aur ductile (taar khinch sakti hain) hain.
Zyada tar metals aur in ke compounds unpaired d electrons ki wajah se paramagnetic (magnet ki taraf khinchne wale) hain.

blocks.alt: Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni aur Cu ke do line charts. Oopar: atomic radius (147, 134, 128, 127, 126, 125, 124, 128 pm) aur ionic radius (86, 79, 80, 81, 76, 74, 69, 73 pm). Neeche: boiling points (3287, 3407, 2672, 2061, 2862, 2870, 2913, 2562 C) aur melting points (1668, 1910, 1907, 1246, 1538, 1495, 1455, 1085 C).
blocks.caption: Figure 18.1: 3d transition elements ke atomic radii, ionic radii, melting points aur boiling points (kitab ki Figure 18.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).
blocks.long_description: Radii titanium se nickel tak ghat'te aur copper par zara barhte hain. Pighalne aur ubalne ke darje manganese par achanak neeche aate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.1 titanium ka melting point 1688 °C chhaapti hai; sahi value 1668 °C hai, is liye drawing mein 1668 likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Line chart ko baen se daen parhein. Oopar: atomic radius Ti se Ni tak thora kam hota hai aur Cu par phir barh jata hai. Neeche: manganese par melting aur boiling point mein gehri kami dekhein, kyun ke is ki metallic bonding kamzor hai. Ionic radius yahan M²⁺ ions ka hai.

blocks.prompt: Figure 18.1 mein pehli row ki kis transition metal ka melting point sab se kam hai?
blocks.explanation: Copper (1085 °C); Ti se Ni mein manganese unusually (ghair maamooli tor par) kam hai (1246 °C).

items: Sakht, chamakdar, malleable aur ductile; bijli aur heat ke achhe conductors.
Oonche melting aur boiling points; density Ti se Cu tak barhti hai; aksar paramagnetic.
